comments.author: Jeidoz
comments.body: It is visually appealing and eye catching art until you spend more than 5s and start notice details 😅

comments.author: vaksninus
comments.body: As others have pointed out, the toes are quite cursed, and is it a gacha game, dating game or something or is the character actually present in the game? I don't think it's bad if the image represents anything related to the game, but this is a character laying down so the viewer doesen't really have any idea what it's about

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Art is very important to marketing so you're definitely right on that but I think what you're missing here is the more you focus on this art that you presented the worse it looks. You need to do more than just leave it to a model to figure out because as many people have mentioned there are very much issues with the art that make it unappealing. The eyes are awful the feet are awful the body contortion is awful the general image composition is poor because the subject is not focused and there's nothing in the background so it's just a ton of dead space in general etc.

comments.author: BoulderRivers
comments.body:
Putting playing, no.  
The rendering looks good, but the rest of it looks terrible.

The problem with AI is that it accelerates you to a result you don't understand.  
It's like winning the lottery at 12. Of course bought 12 Lamborghinis; what else would he do with the money?   
And of course he won't pay "taxes"; he has 12 sports cars, he wont need "taxes" to go anywhere.

That's basically 2 years behind.
